param.controller.tick_s.name: Control interval
param.controller.tick_s.help: How often the controller looks at the surplus and decides. Shorter reacts faster but writes more often; every device write is still limited by the write interval.
param.controller.smoothing_s.name: Surplus smoothing
param.controller.smoothing_s.help: Time window over which the measured surplus is averaged before devices are switched. Longer smoothing avoids switching on short clouds.
param.controller.reserve_w.name: Surplus reserve
param.controller.reserve_w.help: Power that is never handed to devices, as a margin for measurement noise and small loads. A smaller reserve gets closer to the import limit, so it cannot go below the hard limit.
param.controller.deficit_delay_s.name: Deficit delay
param.controller.deficit_delay_s.help: How long controlled devices may cause grid import or battery discharge before the controller backs off. A longer delay lets the deficit last longer, so it is capped.
param.controller.deficit_budget_wh.name: Deficit battery budget
param.controller.deficit_budget_wh.help: Battery energy a single deficit may draw before the controller backs off. Capped by the safety layer.
param.controller.proposal_ttl_s.name: Proposal lifetime
param.controller.proposal_ttl_s.help: In assisted mode a proposal expires after this time if you do not confirm it.
param.controller.intent_max_age_s.name: Maximum age of a command
param.controller.intent_max_age_s.help: A command that is older than this when it reaches the safety layer is dropped as stale. A longer limit lets outdated decisions through, so it is capped.
param.controller.inputs_max_age_ticks.he: Flows and surplus older than this many control intervals count as unknown, and the safety layer then refuses every load increase. Together with the control interval it never exceeds 180 seconds; a larger value is reduced.
param.controller.default_hysteresis_w.he: Power band between switching a device on and off, used for devices that do not set their own. A wider band switches less often.
param.controller.default_hysteresis_dela: How long a condition must hold before a device switches, used for devices that do not set their own.
param.controller.default_settle_s.name: Default settle time
param.controller.default_settle_s.help: Wait after a switch before the result is read back, used for devices that do not set their own. Too short a time reads the device before it has reacted. It also spaces the steps with which SunCore backs off over the import limit, so it is capped at one minute.
param.controller.default_max_switches_pe: Upper limit of switching operations per device and hour, used for devices that do not set their own. Protects relays and compressors; capped by the safety layer.
param.controller.min_write_interval_s.he: Shortest time between two writes to the same device. Protects devices and Home Assistant from rapid writes; it cannot go below the hard limit. It also delays a back-off over the import limit, so it is capped at one minute.
param.controller.release_deadline_s.name: Release deadline
param.controller.release_deadline_s.help: On shutdown or a configuration change, all devices must be handed back within this time.
param.controller.safe_state_cooldown_s.h: After a fault has cleared, control only resumes once the fault has stayed away for this long. A shorter time resumes control sooner, so it cannot go below the hard limit.
param.controller.stale_cadence_factor.he: A slow sensor counts as stale after its usual update interval times this factor without a change. A larger factor tolerates older data, so it is capped.
param.controller.max_jump_w_per_s.name: Plausible power change
param.controller.max_jump_w_per_s.help: Site power that changes faster than this is treated as a unit or sensor fault. A larger value accepts implausible readings, so it is capped.
param.controller.frozen_pv_s.name: Frozen PV detection time
param.controller.frozen_pv_s.help: PV power that stays unchanged for this long in daylight counts as an inverter hang. A longer time detects it later.
param.controller.frozen_pv_min_w.name: Frozen PV minimum power
param.controller.frozen_pv_min_w.help: Below this PV power the frozen-value check does not apply (night, snow).
param.controller.balance_tolerance_w.hel: The measured house load may deviate this much from PV plus grid minus battery before the data counts as inconsistent. A wider tolerance accepts worse data, so it is capped.
param.controller.balance_tolerance_pct.h: Relative part of the balance tolerance. A wider tolerance accepts worse data, so it is capped.
param.planner.budget_s.name: Solver time budget
param.planner.budget_s.help: Time one planner run may take. When the solver misses it, the simple heuristic plan covers the gap. Applies from the next run.
param.planner.mip_gap.name: Solver optimality gap
param.planner.mip_gap.help: Relative distance to the optimum at which the solver stops. Smaller is more exact and slower.
param.planner.min_event_gap_s.name: Minimum gap between triggered runs
param.planner.min_event_gap_s.help: At most one planner run is started by an event (price, forecast or configuration change) in this time.
param.planner.stale_after_s.name: Plan staleness
param.planner.stale_after_s.help: A plan older than this is flagged as stale and is no longer handed to the controller, which then falls back to its default behaviour.
param.planner.soc_deviation_pct.name: SoC deviation for a new plan
param.planner.soc_deviation_pct.help: A new plan is requested when the battery charge differs this much from the plan.
param.planner.net_deviation_w.name: Net power deviation for a new plan
param.planner.net_deviation_w.help: A new plan is requested when PV minus load stays this far from the forecast for the deviation time.
param.planner.net_deviation_s.name: Duration of the net power deviation
param.planner.net_deviation_s.help: How long the net power deviation must last before a new plan is requested.
Turn this on when your plant is paid for feed-in even in hours with a negative spot price (for example older plants not affected by section 51 EEG). Then the region's no-remuneration rule is not applied to your export price. Off keeps the region's rule.
param.tariff.export.negative_reference_e: Spot price sensor for the negative-price rule

Optional sensor with the spot price per kWh. With an all-in tariff such as Tibber the spot price is unknown, so the rule judges the import end price. With this sensor it judges the real spot price for the current slot; later slots keep using the end price. Empty keeps the end price.
param.forecast.learning.min_history_days: Before this many days of history exist, calibration and the machine-learning load model only collect statistics and change nothing.
param.forecast.learning.load_ml_mode.hel: Off: not used. Shadow: runs in parallel and is only scored and shown. Auto: used when it beats the profile forecast in the accuracy statistics.
